Late slip of 650 days for Tommy Tuberville. The disclosure still counts. The timing is the bit.

15 members beat SPY in the 6m window. The benchmark brought its shoes.
John Boozman is behind SPY by -0.8%. Gravity still works.
James Comer and the calendar spent 684 days together. One of them blinked.
Ro Khanna let positions sit 100 days. The badge committee is watching.
Aaron Bean stays on the bench with 0 trades. The threshold is 3, not a vibe.
Pete Sessions rank 1. Alpha +19.1%. The footnote is the methodology page.
Lloyd Doggett closed the timing exam at +13.9%. The class average is SPY.
Party is a label on the card. It is not in the formula, the badges, or this tape.
Alpha is their return minus SPY over the same dates. Apples, meet apples.
